title: No instructions, looks nice.
text:
No instructions, looks nice.. Just got our tree last night, and decorated it, and today received this collar. Good timing.
I have never used a tree collar before.
This is a nice idea, and does look ok. We also wrap the bottom of our tree with
a skirting for the presents under the tree.

I did not know what to expect with this collar, and there are Not any instruction that come with this!!
After looking this over, there are tabs inside along the top and bottom.
Take the longer tubing and put it through the top tabs, then take the shorter tubing and put it through the
the bottom tabs. Do not connect them together till you wrap this around your tree.
The battery pack takes 3 double A batteries..For this price it should have come with batteries!
Look for the battery pack inside.
Then wrap this around the bottom of your tree, and you can velcro it together. I didn’t velcro, as
its a pain in the neck to try and find the battery pack in the back , and turn it on the battery pack every time you use this, and then turn it off.
Maybe the pack could have been in a more user friendly place, or timer batteries that you just have to set one time !.

With this tree we also bought a new tall tree holder that this collar covers., Put sugar water in that , keeps the tree alive longer.
Btw heat up the sugar in water till it dissolves.

I think this is over price. Defiantly made in China, and it shows!!!
